text.aria-label: Subtitle text '16 Primary substations, 158 daily forecast runs (every second week of July 2025 to June 2026). Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months. Rule at zero: same score. Below zero: the first arm is better.'
text.tspan: 16 Primary substations, 158 daily forecast runs (every second week of July 2025 to June 2026).
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months.
Rule at zero: same score. Below zero: the first arm is better.
